answer: Require a new key to earn its first full payout through three unrelated microtasks. At enrollment, the scheduler assigns a fresh lantern-fault diagnosis, tide forecast, and saffron-grade check; independent scoring must pass all three before the key leaves the capped trial tier. Proposed review fee: 0.03 POA per identity; 0.03 × 1,000 = 30 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.03 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: a capable operator can automate or outsource the diverse tests.
